text: I am glad that you have decided to purposefully work for a month with the theme of love and relationships, and more precisely with the complex of emotional and bodily states connected with the harmony of the fourth chakra. At first glance, love is such a natural state (like air) that there is nothing to talk about. However, in society there are many both motivating and prohibitive scenarios that control our behavior, sometimes leading to loneliness, resentments, jealousy, and even illnesses that psychosomatically manifest in the chest area. By performing practices on the yoga mat and in life, reflecting, correcting your thoughts and actions, over the course of a month you can obtain important results that will manifest both at the level of the body (healing) and at the level of the psychological background (satisfaction and happiness).
